purpose: Repeatable preliminary structural/cost comparisons; not a construction design

floor.patch_location: east and north edges, editable provisional zoning
floor.occupancy_classification: not determined; 40psf owner study target, not approval of applicable code minimum

equipment.additional_machine_description: Owner said maybe 3 lb over4ft²; ambiguous, not silently changed to300lb

roof.note: Preliminary previous assembly allowances; replace with manufacturer takeoff; no final snow/wind/seismic determination

walls.note: Preliminary lightweight insulated metal cladding allowance

cost.objective: material + shop labor + site labor + connections + delivery/lifting + foundations
cost.fabrication_preference: least total cost, compare shop-weld/site-bolt versus field-weld

release_policy: Do not silently assign rigid joints; compare ideal moment-connected upper bound and released-web/frame sensitivities; unstable cases are rejected, not stabilized with fictitious supports
approval_gate: No automatic construction-ready or all-requirements-met result before connection, lateral, second-order, foundation and erection-stage design
